selection.rule: highest pooled LOAO endpoint-param macro-F1 over the non-benchmark groups, fixed before DVPWA is collected or scored

freeze.source_hash_covers: sha256 of the sorted lines '<sha256(file)>  <path>' over `git ls-files` at the commit
freeze.ground_truth_hash_covers: json.dumps({app, endpoints, skip, passive, stored, csrf} for dvpwa, sort_keys=True)
freeze.rule: DVPWA is labelled from source only and never collected for training or tuning; it is collected and scored exactly once by scripts/eval_final_v4.py after the v4 model is fixed by SHA-256. v2 (deployed) and v3 are scored on the same collection.

metric: ML: endpoint-param macro-F1 over the classes present, per-class P/R/F1, cluster bootstrap 1000 (paired v4/v2/v3); rules/passive/stored/CSRF: counts
deployment_rule: v4 replaces v2 as the deployed model only if (a) its DVPWA endpoint-param macro-F1 is higher than v2's on the same records AND (b) in leave-one-app-out on the same endpoint-params v4 is not significantly worse than v2 (the 95% CI of v2 - v4 does not lie entirely above 0, reports/before_after_v4.json). Otherwise v2 stays deployed and v4 is packaged as models/release_v4.
